I added a 0.25s sleep after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`. That caps the loop at about 4 requests per second, under the sandbox's 5 per second limit. I haven't run the test, so I don't know yet whether it fixes the CI flake.

The spacing is a `CALL_SPACING_S` constant at the top of the file, so you can adjust it in one place. The sleep also runs after the last request, which adds a harmless quarter second.

I also saved a note about the sandbox rate limit to EngramDB, so it's there if this comes up again.
